description: Predict pre-action workflow risk, blast radius, and remediations before a tool call executes.

baseBranch.description: Optional protected base branch override (defaults to main)

branches.description: Optional parallel workflow branches for fan-out budget and review checks.

budget.description: Optional per-action budget controls: maxTokensPerAction, remainingTokens, maxCostUsdPerAction, remainingCostUsd, maxParallelBranches

changedFiles.description: Optional affected-file list used to estimate blast radius

command.description: Optional shell command when toolName is Bash

content.description: Provider-native message content blocks; Anthropic tool_use blocks are normalized automatically

costUsd.description: Estimated USD cost for this action when provider usage is unavailable

filePath.description: Optional primary file path for edit-like tools

financialControl.description: Single-use purchase authorization scope from the append-only financial ledger.

goal.description: Optional agent goal for open-ended tool planning.

method.description: Optional JSON-RPC/MCP method, such as tools/call

model.description: Optional model name used for audit evidence and budget review

params.description: Optional JSON-RPC/MCP params, including tools/call name and arguments, resources/read URI, or prompts/get template arguments

provider.description: Optional provider name, such as anthropic, openai, codex, cursor, gemini, or mcp

providerToolCall.description: Provider-native tool call object, including Anthropic tool_use or OpenAI function/tool call shapes

repoPath.description: Optional repository path used for git-aware integrity checks

requirePrForReleaseSensitive.description: When true, release-sensitive changes on non-base branches require an open PR

requireVersionNotBehindBase.description: When true, release-sensitive changes cannot lag behind the base branch package version

routes.description: Optional routing workflow destinations or classes.

steps.description: Optional predefined workflow steps for chaining/evaluator workflow audit evidence.

tokenEstimate.description: Estimated total tokens for this action when provider usage is unavailable

toolName.description: Tool being assessed, such as Bash, Edit, or Write. Optional when provider-native tool call payload is supplied.

tools.description: Optional abstract/combinable tool names available to an open-ended agent.

usage.description: Provider token/cost usage, such as input_tokens, output_tokens, or total_tokens

workflow.description: Optional workflow metadata: pattern, steps, routes, branches, tools, inspection, and verification evidence.

workflowPattern.description: Optional workflow architecture hint. Agents require inspection evidence; predefined workflows are easier to evaluate.

name: workflow_sentinel
title: Workflow Sentinel
